name: order_lookup
description: Look up all orders for a given customer. Returns order details including product IDs, purchase dates, and order status.

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C-01

name: user_lookup
description: Look up customer details by customer ID. Returns the customer name and country code.

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C-01

name: product_lookup
description: Look up product details by product ID. Returns the product name, category, and provider.

product_id.description: The unique product identifier, e.g. P-001

name: find_returned_products
description: Find all orders with RETURNED status across all customers. Returns order details enriched with product names from the product catalog.

name: process_refund
description: Process a refund for a specific order. Updates the order status to REFUNDED and returns confirmation with product details. Requires both customer_id and product_id to identify the order.

customer_id.description: The customer identifier who placed the order, e.g. C-01

product_id.description: The product identifier for the order to refund, e.g. P-001
